title: STRONG exact calculus, finite PC and hereditary selectors
index_title: STRONG exact calculus, finite PC and hereditary selectors
scope: Bounded Foundations III module ending at named-sort HS. SIR, safe augmented EPPA readings and terminal pure-power applications remain separate. The RAW exact module is not a theorem prerequisite.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Scope records whether SAP, CCO and full sortwise NR2 are used; the pure-tag engine retains its explicit no-return premise.

assumptions.name: Actual homogeneous named-sorted SAP source
assumptions.statement: Finite complete binary relational language on finite inhabited named transitive sorts, symmetric loop diversity atoms and correctly typed converses; actual homogeneous source whose finite age has SAP. Logical equality is separate. Triangle-definedness, countability and primitivity are unnecessary for the local arguments.

assumptions.name: Additional semantic homomorphic CCO
assumptions.statement: For the CCO branches only, every finite specified typed diversity diagram whose specified simple cycles map homomorphically to the actual source itself maps homomorphically there.

assumptions.name: Additional FULL original sortwise NR2
assumptions.statement: For the loop-stabilization/no-return and unconditional HS route, each named original sort has no relative-index-two interval in its FULL invariant equivalence lattice.

definitions.name: Actual named-sorted SAP source
definitions.statement: An actual homogeneous complete finite binary RELATIONAL source on finitely many inhabited transitive named sorts. Same-sort diversity atoms are symmetric; cross-sort atoms have typed converses. Its actual finite age has SAP.

source.anchor: The algebraic arguments below use only

definitions.name: Diversity palettes and strong triangles
definitions.statement: L_ij is the finite nonempty set of actual atoms on DISTINCT vertices of types i,j. Logical equality is never an element of L_ii. Every legal triangle uses three distinct real vertices.

definitions.name: Boolean strong product
definitions.statement: A*B is the set of output diversity atoms of actual legal typed triangles with inputs in A,B. Empty Boolean subsets are allowed temporarily but are not exact menus.

definitions.name: Positive word profile
definitions.statement: A nonempty composable atomic diversity word evaluates by strong products. Its formal path vertices are distinct. Absent multipliers later mean identity ACTIONS, not empty-word menus.

definitions.name: Original strong exact family
definitions.statement: Nonempty evaluated finite intersections of positive word profiles; the empty restriction list gives diversity Top. Discard adjoined Top restrictions before choosing actual defining words. Menus remain tagged by ordered endpoints.

definitions.name: All-coordinate PC
definitions.statement: For A:i→j, B:j→k, C:i→k, PC means C⊆A*B, A⊆C*B̄, B⊆Ā*C. Menu variables and sorts may repeat, but root vertices are distinct.

definitions.name: Finite PC iteration
definitions.statement: On ordered DISTINCT vertex pairs initialize specified diversity edges to singletons and unrecorded pairs to typed Top. Repeatedly intersect with all strong two-step products through distinct third vertices; Boolean zero may occur.

source.anchor: For a finite old atomic typed partial graph

definitions.name: Joint pruning, exact contraction and HS
definitions.statement: Pruning outputs nonempty subsets, is conservative, converse-compatible and preserves all PC triples. Survivor heredity means E⊆D and E∩R(D)≠∅ imply R(E)=E∩R(D). An exact contraction stays in original H; HS outputs atomic singletons.

definitions.name: Current family
definitions.statement: A tagged converse-closed subfamily J of ORIGINAL H, containing every atomic singleton and downward closed among original nonempty exact submenus. No multiplication closure is assumed.

definitions.name: Visible filter and gate
definitions.statement: A tagged original exact family F closed under converse and left/right multiplication by arbitrary original exact menus. Visibility: parallel F-menus meeting a current D intersect each other. G(D)=D intersect all F-menus meeting D. Empty active list leaves D fixed.

definitions.name: Full original sortwise NR2
definitions.statement: No named original sort admits invariant equivalences R<S with exactly two R-classes in one S-class. These are ALL actual invariant equivalences, not just exact ones.

source.anchor: no named sort admits a proper relative-index-two

definitions.name: Generated families and pure tag action
definitions.statement: F(C) closes a seed under original multiplication and converse. A finite pure tag group Λ fixes literal fine-colour names and transports sort signatures, legal triangles, converse, original exact menus and multiplication. F_Λ(C) also closes under Λ. Conditional no-return is: for every C and parallel A,B∈F_Λ(C), F_Λ(A)=F_Λ(B) implies A=B. It is not inferred for an arbitrary nontrivial action.

claims.name: Boolean triangle algebra
claims.statement: Strong products are monotone, union-preserving, converse-reversing and satisfy correctly typed atomic Peirce. PC rotations follow from triangle permutation.

claims.name: SAP strong algebra and Set-Pasch
claims.statement: Compatible nonempty products are nonempty, strong composition is associative, Top absorbs nonempty factors, and Set-Pasch holds by SAP gluing over complete points/edges. Loop menus commute.

claims.name: Supported-fork duplication
claims.statement: For an atom c:i→k and any X:i→j, X⊆{c}*{c̄}*X. In particular every nonempty loop P satisfies P⊆P³.

claims.name: Infinite stabilizer orbits
claims.statement: Every point outside a finite complete real base has infinitely many images under its pointwise stabilizer, by arbitrarily many SAP copies and finite homogeneity.

claims.name: Injectivization and guarded word equivalence
claims.statement: Any finite diversity homomorphism can be made injective, fixing an already injective designated set and avoiding a finite forbidden set outside it. Positive strong profiles equal represented word profiles guarded to distinct endpoints after deleting identity letters.

claims.name: Strong cycle completion with fixed complete base
claims.statement: A finite typed diversity diagram has an injective completion iff every specified simple cycle has a homomorphism. Any prescribed complete old base can be fixed after homogeneity alignment.

claims.name: Theta Helly and exact endpoint semantics
claims.statement: Merged private-path theta diagrams give positive-profile and exact-menu 2-Helly, converse/nonempty-result meet closure, and realization of every atom of a presented exact menu. Use a single pinned root if a CCO map merges roots.

claims.name: Exact strong convolution and distribution
claims.statement: For nonempty exact A=⋂r P_r,B=⋂s Q_s, A*B=⋂rs(P_r*Q_s), including empty-list Top. Nonempty exact factors distribute over exact meets with NONEMPTY EVALUATION. All products remain in original H.

claims.name: Three-root exact occurrence iff PC
claims.statement: Three menus occur as their full endpoint survivor domains at three distinct roots iff all three PC support inclusions hold. Use three private theta gadgets and prescribed supported root triples.

claims.name: Finite PC greatestness and survivor induction
claims.statement: The finite monotone decreasing Boolean iteration terminates at the greatest stable refinement of its initial network. Every atomic assignment from an injective completion survives every update.

claims.name: Stable support propagates along simple paths
claims.statement: A stable refinement of the initial network of G is included on each endpoint pair in the strong profile of every specified simple path, by induction and associativity.

claims.name: PC simple-path formula
claims.statement: If every fixed domain is nonempty, D∞(x,y) equals the intersection of all specified simple x–y path profiles, with empty family Top. Each surviving atom extends to an injective completion of the whole graph.

claims.name: Canonical exact PC domains and triples
claims.statement: Nonempty fixed domains of strongly completable diagrams equal original H. Three such domains occur simultaneously at three distinct roots iff PC; the theta path formula and exact distribution give the requested domains exactly.

claims.name: Visible gate basic properties
claims.statement: Visibility plus exact Helly makes G(D) nonempty original exact and current; active-list transport gives converse; equal active lists on surviving E⊆D give G(E)=E∩G(D). This preliminary lemma precedes bilateral support.

claims.name: Bilateral support preservation
claims.statement: If D⊆P*E and E⊆P̄*D, a visible gate preserves both inclusions with the SAME original exact P. P need not be current. Converse gives the right-factor version.

claims.name: Supported restricted menus for each surviving atom
claims.statement: For PC(A,B,C) and c∈G(C), original exact A_c=A∩({c}*B̄), B_c=B∩(Ā*{c}) meet G(A),G(B). Heredity identifies their gates, and duplication/distribution give A_c⊆{c}*B̄_c and B̄_c⊆{c̄}*A_c.

claims.name: All three PC coordinates survive a gate
claims.statement: Bilateral support on restricted menus yields every c∈G(C) in G(A)*G(B); both typed rotations give the other two support inclusions, even for repeated menus/sort labels.

claims.name: Gate image, composition and strict measure
claims.statement: The gate image equals its fixed family, is downward and converse closed, and contains all singletons. Consecutive gates on successive images retain heredity, PC and converse. A proper active trace removes a menu from the image and strictly decreases its cardinality.

claims.name: Stable even and odd loop powers
claims.statement: For nonempty loop P, Pⁿ⊆Pⁿ⁺² for positive n≥1; there is no zeroth strong menu power. Finiteness gives stable even J and odd O satisfying J²=J, JO=O, O²=J, P⊆O.

claims.name: Disjoint parity gives a full invariant index-two interval
claims.statement: If J,O from C19 intersect they are equal; otherwise R=Id∪J and S=Id∪J∪O are actual invariant equivalences and [S:R]=2, contradicting full sortwise NR2. Equality cases and existence/closure of the second R-class are explicit.

claims.name: Consecutive loop-power stabilization
claims.statement: Under full sortwise NR2, every nonempty loop exact P has Pⁿ=Pⁿ⁺¹ for all sufficiently large n. The stable menu need not be Top; no CCO is used in this power argument.

claims.name: Generated-family normal forms
claims.statement: Every original product/converse-generated menu has form P*C*Q or P*C̄*Q, with absent outside multipliers interpreted as identity actions. H-product closure justifies exactness.

claims.name: Parallel return transformations
claims.statement: For parallel returns, same-orientation outside multipliers are loops; reverse returns reduce using self-converse loop P*C̄=C*P̄. Returning maps T(X)=L*X*R commute through loop factors only.

claims.name: Parallel no-return under NR2
claims.statement: If two parallel original exact menus generate the same converse/product family, they are equal. Commuting return maps and uniform eventual loop-power stabilization give T(A)=A.

claims.name: Minimal viable generated family is visible
claims.statement: ASSUMING the pure-action generated no-return premise, a viable seed with minimum generated-family cardinality has relative visibility: a failure would yield a viable strictly smaller generated family.

claims.name: Finite pure-tag gate engine
claims.statement: Under its explicit pure tag action and generated no-return premise, start at Λ-invariant J₀=H and iterate visible gates on ORIGINAL exact current families. Each strictly decreases the number of menus, has Λ-invariant domain/image, preserves covariance and all contraction properties, and terminates in singletons within the stated menu-count bound.

claims.name: Joint hereditary selector for named sorts
claims.statement: Use the trivial tag group in C26; C24 supplies its no-return premise. Obtain one conservative converse-compatible selector preserving all PC coordinates and survivor heredity, without arbitrary fine-colour covariance or safe-reading conclusions.

controls.check: F2² translation AP+CCO source without SAP: strong product can be empty/nonassociative, and represented positive walks need not be injective.
Three-level ultrametric palette with two named sorts: exact products, all-coordinate PC, pure-tag visible gates, image/heredity and finite selector descent.
A two-block equivalence palette has alternating loop powers and no PC-preserving selector on Top; NR2 is necessary here.
Swapping literal colours of a free two-colour palette admits no invariant singleton choice on Top; pure-tag scope cannot be replaced by arbitrary colour covariance.
Exhaust all 4096 four-vertex partial diagrams in a three-level ultrametric palette: PC fixed survivors equal actual completion survivors and all simple-path intersections.
